full_name: Carolyn Abbate | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2006–2007 Humanities Radcliffe Alumnae Professor Harvard University
bio: Carolyn Abbate was appointed a tenured professor by the Department of Music at Harvard University in 2005 and held the first Radcliffe Alumnae Professorship.
